title: Appoint a liquor approved manager
summary: Corporate licensees with a liquor licence must notify Liquor & Gaming NSW when appointing a liquor approved manager.
intro:
If a corporation holds a liquor licence, the corporate licensee must:

You can notify Liquor & Gaming NSW online.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: A corporation that holds a liquor licence and is the corporate licensee.
what_you_need: Details of the liquor licence and licensee, including contact details.
Details of the approved manager, including details of their approval.
The PDF form: Declaration by organisation – PDF

how_to_steps.text: Enter your liquor licence number (including the letters) and your name.
Upload all the required supporting documentation.

more_info.text: You cannot appoint a manager who is already appointed as the manager of another licensed premises.
A registered club with a single premises does not need to appoint a manager because the secretary of the club is taken to be the manager.
A registered club with multiple premises will need to appoint a manager, and notify Liquor & Gaming NSW for each premises other than the main premises.
